name: backlog
description: v0.1.7: closed CA-backlog-003 — widened the tasks-file lock's stale-reap window (5s→10s) and the blocking-acquire retry budget (150ms→2s) so a live holder legitimately mid-critical-section (e.g. `add`'s bounded `is_claimed_elsewhere` subprocess call) can no longer be reaped by a waiting racer, and made `mark_done`/`mark_failed` idempotent (a repeat call on an already-done/failed task id is now a true no-op instead of re-stamping timestamps or re-appending notes) so at-least-once callers (retry-on-timeout, /flow re-driving a step) are safe to call twice. Also carries v0.1.6: closed 2 CONFIRMED Continuous-Audit fail-opens (CA-backlog-001/002) — added an opt-in atomic `next --claim` so two concurrent claimers can no longer both win the same pending task, and bounded the `condukt state is-claimed` subprocess call to well under the tasks-file lock's stale-reap window so a hung subprocess can no longer cause a lost update. Cross-project task queue with cycle-type tags for Claude Code: a /backlog skill (thin alias to /flow for driver loop), a SessionStart hook that surfaces pending work at session open, and a backlog binary with list/next/done/fail/lock subcommands. The lock→pick→/condukt→done driver loop is consolidated in /flow. Subscription-native (skill + hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).
